/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectWebTrlInspKndList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT AA.NO AS TRL_MLSFC_CD, /* 검사번호 */ AA.NM1 AS TRL_MLSFC_NM, /* 검사종류 */ AA.NM2 AS TRL_LCLAS_NM, /* 검사구분 */ NVL(BB.CNT,0) AS TOT_CNT, /* 실시건수 */ NVL(CC.CNT,0) AS REPLE_CNT /* 댓글건수 */ FROM ( SELECT A.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 NO, /* 검사번호 */ A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM NM1, /* 검사종류 */ B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM NM2 /* 검사구분 */ FROM SAC100 A , SAC100 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 IS NOT NULL AND B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD' AND A.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) AA, ( SELECT KOGU_PVSN_NO NO, COUNT(*) CNT FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY KOGU_PVSN_NO ) BB, ( SELECT A.TRL_INSP_SN NO, COUNT(*) CNT FROM AYE100 A, AYE110 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE('20230601' || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE('20230630' || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY A.TRL_INSP_SN ) CC WHERE AA.NO = BB.NO(+) AND AA.NO = CC.NO(+) ORDER BY AA.NO

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectTwdpsnRelPreconList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT AA.NM AS NM, /* 패턴명 */ NVL(BB.LCNT,0) AS LCNT, /* 하 */ NVL(BB.MCNT,0) AS MCNT, /* 중 */ NVL(BB.HCNT,0) AS HCNT, /* 상 */ BB.CNT AS CNT /* 합계 */ FROM ( SELECT WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO NO, WEPOS_PTTRN_NM NM FROM AYD330 WHERE WEPOS_SCLAS_SN = #{WEPOS_SCLAS_SN} /* 대인관계고민 , 대인관계원인 */ ) AA, ( SELECT WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO NO,
SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_PTTRN_SUM_SCORE < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) LCNT, /* 20점만점기준으로 40%미만: 하 */
SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_PTTRN_SUM_SCORE BETWEEN 4 AND 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MCNT, /* 20점만점기준으로 40%~60%: 중 */
SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_PTTRN_SUM_SCORE > 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) HCNT, /* 20점만점기준으로 60%초과: 상 */
COUNT(*) CNT FROM AYD500 WHERE 1 = 1
AND WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO BETWEEN 1 AND 8 /* 패턴 */
AND WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO BETWEEN 9 AND 17 /* 패턴 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO ) BB WHERE AA.NO = BB.NO(+) ORDER BY AA.NO

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectTwdpsnRelResultList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT A.USER_ID AS ID, TO_CHAR(A.EVL_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS YMD, B.WEPOS_PTTRN_NM AS NM, A.WEPOS_PTTRN_SUM_SCORE AS SCORE, CASE
WHEN A.WEPOS_PTTRN_SUM_SCORE < 4 THEN '하' WHEN A.WEPOS_PTTRN_SUM_SCORE BETWEEN 4 AND 12 THEN '중' WHEN A.WEPOS_PTTRN_SUM_SCORE > 12 THEN '상' ELSE ''
END AS RESULT FROM AYD500 A , AYD330 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO = B.WEPOS_ANS_PTTRN_NO
AND A.EVL_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.EVL_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND B.WEPOS_SCLAS_SN = #{WEPOS_SCLAS_SN} /* 대인관계고민 , 대인관계원인 */ ORDER BY TO_CHAR(A.EVL_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24') DESC, A.USER_ID, A.EVL_SCORE_SN

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectCoupleAngerAspectCrtronPreconList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT MAX(A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM1) AS NM, /* 패턴명(껍질형,안개형,난장이형,산만형,군림형) */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'a' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,3,1) = 'L' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'b' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,7,1) = 'L' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'c' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,11,1) = 'L' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'd' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,15,1) = 'L' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'e' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,19,1) = 'L' THEN 1
ELSE 0 END),0) AS LCNT, /* 하 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'a' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,3,1) = 'M' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'b' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,7,1) = 'M' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'c' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,11,1) = 'M' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'd' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,15,1) = 'M' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'e' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,19,1) = 'M' THEN 1
ELSE 0 END),0) AS MCNT, /* 중 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'a' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,3,1) = 'H' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'b' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,7,1) = 'H' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'c' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,11,1) = 'H' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'd' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,15,1) = 'H' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'e' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,19,1) = 'H' THEN 1
ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 상 */ COUNT(*) AS CNT /* 합계 */ FROM AYD430 A , AYD440 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = #{TRL_INSP_MNG_NO} /* 관리번호 */
AND A.QESITM_NO IN ('1','13') /* 패턴 */
AND A.QESITM_NO IN ('1','2','3') /* 패턴 */
AND A.QESITM_NO IN ('1','2','3','4','5') /* 패턴 */
AND B.KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM ORDER BY A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectCoupleAngerAspectCrtronResultList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ WITH PETTERN AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'a' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) A, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'b' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) B, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'c' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) C, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'd' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) D, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'e' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) E FROM AYD430 WHERE TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = #{TRL_INSP_MNG_NO} ) SELECT B.WRTR_ID AS ID, /* 아이디 */ TO_CHAR(B.WRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS YMD, /* 실시일자 */
CASE WHEN B.SXDC_SE_CD = 'F' THEN '여' WHEN B.SXDC_SE_CD = 'M' THEN '남' ELSE ' ' END AS SXDC, /* 성별 */
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_SUM_CN, 'a:',PT.A),'b:',PT.B),'c:',PT.C),'d:',PT.D) ,'e:',PT.E) AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM,'a:',PT.A),'b:',PT.B),'c:',PT.C),'d:',PT.D) ,'e:',PT.E) AS RESULT /* 결과 */ FROM AYD440 B , PETTERN PT WHERE 1=1 AND B.KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
ORDER BY B.WRTR_ID, B.WRT_DT

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectCoseSchulwPreconList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT MAX(A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM1) AS NM, /* 패턴명 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '1' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,3,1) = 'L' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '2' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,7,1) = 'L' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '3' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,11,1) = 'L' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '4' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,15,1) = 'L' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '5' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,19,1) = 'L' THEN 1
ELSE 0 END),0) AS LCNT, /* 하 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '1' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,3,1) = 'M' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '2' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,7,1) = 'M' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '3' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,11,1) = 'M' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '4' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,15,1) = 'M' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '5' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,19,1) = 'M' THEN 1
ELSE 0 END),0) AS MCNT, /* 중 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '1' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,3,1) = 'H' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '2' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,7,1) = 'H' THEN 1 WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '3' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,11,1) = 'H' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '4' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,15,1) = 'H' THEN 1
WHEN A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '5' AND SUBSTR(B.WEPOS_RESULT_NM,19,1) = 'H' THEN 1
ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 상 */ COUNT(*) AS CNT /* 합계 */ FROM AYD430 A , AYD440 B
WHERE 1=1 AND A.TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = #{TRL_INSP_MNG_NO} /* 관리번호 */
AND A.QESITM_NO IN ('1','2','3') /* 패턴 */
AND A.QESITM_NO IN ('1','2','3','4') /* 패턴 */
AND A.QESITM_NO IN ('1','2','3','4','5') /* 패턴 */
AND B.KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM ORDER BY A.WEPOS_FCTR_NM

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectCoseSchulwResultList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ WITH PETTERN AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '1' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) A, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '2' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) B, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '3' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) C, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '4' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) D, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '5' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) E FROM AYD430 WHERE TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = #{TRL_INSP_MNG_NO} ) SELECT B.WRTR_ID AS ID, /* 아이디 */ TO_CHAR(B.WRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS YMD, /* 실시일자 */
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_SUM_CN, '/', '</br>'), '1:',PT.A),'2:',PT.B),'3:',PT.C),'4:',PT.D) ,'5:',PT.E) AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM, '/', '</br>'),'1:',PT.A),'2:',PT.B),'3:',PT.C),'4:',PT.D) ,'5:',PT.E) AS RESULT /* 결과 */
FROM AYD440 B , PETTERN PT WHERE 1=1 AND B.KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
ORDER BY B.WRTR_ID, B.WRT_DT

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectCoseDirectivityPreconList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT '진로지향성' AS NM, /* 패턴명 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:LL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LLCNT, /* 가장낮음 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LCNT, /* 낮음 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:LM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LMCNT, /* 중간낮음 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MCNT, /* 중간 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:HM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HMCNT, /* 중간보다높음 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:LH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LHCNT, /* 다소높음 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 높음 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:HH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HHCNT, /* 가장높음 */ COUNT(*) AS CNT /* 합계 */ FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectAddictionStressPreconList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT #{PATTERN_TITLE} AS NM, /* 패턴명 */
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'k:L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LCNT, /* 일반사용자군 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'k:M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MCNT, /* 주의사용자군 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'k:H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 위험사용자군 */
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 's:L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LCNT, /* 일반사용자군 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 's:M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MCNT, /* 주의사용자군 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 's:H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 위험사용자군 */
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'p:L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS NCNT, /* 비문제 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'p:M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS DCNT, /* 위험 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'p:H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 고위험 */
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'p:L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LCNT, /* 하 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'p:M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MCNT, /* 중 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'p:H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 상 */
COUNT(*) AS CNT /* 합계 */ FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectAddictionStressResultList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */
WITH PETTERN AS ( SELECT
MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '1' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) A, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '2' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) B, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '3' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) C, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = '4' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) D
MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'a' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) A, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'b' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) B, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'c' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) C
FROM AYD430 WHERE TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = #{TRL_INSP_MNG_NO} )
SELECT B.WRTR_ID AS ID, /* 아이디 */ TO_CHAR(B.WRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS YMD, /* 실시일자 */
CASE WHEN B.ACBG_SE_CD = '1' THEN '초등' WHEN B.ACBG_SE_CD = '2' THEN '중등' WHEN B.ACBG_SE_CD = '3' THEN '고등' ELSE ' ' END AS ACBG, /* 학교 */
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_SUM_CN,'k:','합계:'),'1:',PT.A),'2:',PT.B),'3:',PT.C) ,'4:',PT.D) AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(B.WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM,'k:','') AS RESULT /* 결과 */
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_SUM_CN,'s:','합계:'),'1:',PT.A),'2:',PT.B),'3:',PT.C) ,'4:',PT.D) AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(B.WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM,'s:','') AS RESULT /* 결과 */
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_SUM_CN,'s:','합계:'),'a:',PT.A),'b:',PT.B),'c:',PT.C) AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(B.WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM,'s:',' ') AS RESULT /* 결과 */
REPLACE(B.WEPOS_SUM_CN, 'p:','') AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(B.WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM,'p:','') AS RESULT /* 결과 */
FROM AYD440 B
, PETTERN PT
WHERE 1=1 AND B.KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
ORDER BY B.WRTR_ID, B.WRT_DT

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectEmtStablePreconList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT '정서안정성' AS NM, /* 패턴명 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:LL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LLCNT, /* 최하 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:LH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LHCNT, /* 하 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:ML' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MLCNT, /* 중하 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:MM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MMCNT, /* 중 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:MH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MHCNT, /* 중상 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:HL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HLCNT, /* 상하 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:HM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HMCNT, /* 상 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_NM = 'b:HH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HHCNT, /* 최상 */ COUNT(*) AS CNT /* 합계 */ FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectSoctyAnxietParntsADHDDepresPreconList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT #{PATTERN_TITLE} AS NM, /* 패턴명 */
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:비문제/' OR WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:비문제1/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS NCNT, /* 비문제 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:고위험/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 고위험 */
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:비문제/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS NCNT, /* 비문제 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:문제/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS MCNT, /* 문제 */
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:비문제/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS NCNT, /* 비문제 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:가벼움/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LCNT, /* 가벼움 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:위험/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS DCNT, /* 위험 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM = 's:고위험/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HCNT, /* 고위험 */
COUNT(*) AS CNT /* 합계 */ FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectSoctyAnxietParntsADHDDepresResultList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT WRTR_ID AS ID, /* 아이디 */ TO_CHAR(WRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS YMD, /* 실시일자 */ REPLACE(REPLACE(WEPOS_SUM_CN, 's:',''),'/', ' ') AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(REPLACE(WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM,'s:',''),'/', ' ') AS RESULT /* 결과 */ FROM AYD440 WHERE 1=1 AND KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectMomNurtureEfficaResultList - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ WITH PETTERN AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'a' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) A, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'b' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) B, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'c' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) C, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'd' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) D, MAX(CASE WHEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM = 'e' THEN WEPOS_FCTR_NM1 || ':' ELSE '' END) E FROM AYD430 WHERE TRL_INSP_MNG_NO = #{TRL_INSP_MNG_NO} ) SELECT B.WRTR_ID AS ID, /* 아이디 */ TO_CHAR(B.WRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS YMD, /* 실시일자 */
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_SUM_CN, '/', '</br>'), 's:','총점:'),'a:',PT.a),'b:',PT.b),'c:',PT.c),'d:',PT.d) ,'e:',PT.e) AS SCORE, /* 원점수 */ REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.WEPOS_RESULT_DTL_NM, '/', '</br>'),'s:','총점:'),'a:',PT.a),'b:',PT.b),'c:',PT.c),'d:',PT.d) ,'e:',PT.e) AS RESULT /* 결과 */
FROM AYD440 B , PETTERN PT WHERE 1=1 AND B.KOGU_PVSN_NO = #{WEPOS_MLSFC_SN} /* 가이던스번호 */
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
ORDER BY B.WRTR_ID, B.WRT_DT

/* * isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.WebTrlInspStatsMapper.selectWebTrlInspDgstfnKndDetail - 응용2팀 지원 정원제 */ SELECT AA.NO AS NO, /* 문항번호 */ AA.CN AS CN, /* 문항내용 */ BB.CNT1 AS CNT1, /* 1점건수 */ BB.CNT2 AS CNT2, /* 2점건수 */ BB.CNT3 AS CNT3, /* 3점건수 */ BB.CNT4 AS CNT4, /* 4점건수 */ BB.CNT5 AS CNT5, /* 5점건수 */
CASE WHEN (CNT1 + CNT2 + CNT3 + CNT4 + CNT5) > 0 THEN (CNT1 + CNT2*2 + CNT3*3 + CNT4*4 + CNT5*5)/(CNT1 + CNT2 + CNT3 + CNT4 + CNT5) ELSE 0 END AS AVER /* 평균만족도 */
FROM ( SELECT QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AS NO, /* 문항번호 */ QESITM_CN AS CN /* 문항내용 */ FROM AYE197 WHERE 1=1 AND QESITM_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' /* 웹심리 */ ) AA, ( SELECT C.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AS NO, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN C.RSPNS_CN = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT1, /* 1점건수 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN C.RSPNS_CN = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT2, /* 2점건수 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN C.RSPNS_CN = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT3, /* 3점건수 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN C.RSPNS_CN = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT4, /* 4점건수 */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN C.RSPNS_CN = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT5 /* 5점건수 */ FROM AYE100 A , AYE195 B , AYE196 C WHERE 1=1 AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.TRL_INSP_SN = #{TRL_INSP_SN} /* 리스트에서 클릭한 검사번호 */ AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분 */ AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND B.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND C.INDEX_SN = B.INDEX_SN AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY C.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO ) BB WHERE AA.NO = BB.NO(+) ORDER BY AA.NO
